name: Supreme Court of India: Open the judgment-date search
summary: Open the judgment-date search, fill a date window and return the CAPTCHA image as a PNG data URL. Pair with sci/judgements-by-date in the same tab.
description: First half of a judgment-date search. Opens https://www.sci.gov.in/judgements-judgement-date/, fills from_date and to_date (dd-mm-yyyy, at most 30 days apart), waits for the page to load its CAPTCHA image, and returns that image as a PNG data URL. The tab stays parked on the filled form; sci/judgements-by-date then types the answer, searches and reads the results.

to_date.description: Window end, dd-mm-yyyy. The site allows at most 30 days after from_date.

steps.name: Wait for the search form (fails on a block or error page)
Return the CAPTCHA image as a PNG

help.summary: Open the judgment-date form for a window and return the CAPTCHA image.

parameters.to_date: Window end, dd-mm-yyyy, at most 30 days after from_date.

examples.command: rzn-browser run sci judgements-open --param from_date=01-01-2019 --param to_date=31-01-2019

notes: The page reloads its CAPTCHA 2 seconds after load; the step waits for that before reading the image.
Run sci/judgements-by-date next, in the same tab, with the answer.
